anomalies.observed: On the SkylabModule sheet, net NET0017 (SKW92A pin on the LAN_PORT3 header row) has a junction at the top of its vertical wire. A horizontal wire from that junction runs to a GND symbol, so NET0017 is tied to ground. On the EPD_Driver sheet, the same NET0017 label sits on J7 pin 14, which the drawing places on the EPD's data/command interface.
anomalies.expected: The EPD data line on J7 pin 14 should connect only to its SKW92A signal pin and must not be tied to ground. The spec maps J1.14 (SDA) to a signal line driven by the module, not to GND.

evidence.quote: NET0017 label with junction at the top of the vertical wire, horizontal wire from GND symbol (SkylabModule sheet, page 2, top-right area)
J7 pin 14 labelled NET0017 (EPD_Driver sheet, page 3)

anomalies.impact: The EPD data line is shorted to ground through the module's GND connection, so the SPI/data signal to the display cannot toggle and the panel will not receive commands or image data. The short could also load or damage the module's pin driver.
